arxiv-1910-01920.title: A Non-static Quantum inspired Spacetime in f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) Gravity: Gravity’s Rainbow
arxiv-1910-01920.creator: Prabir Rudra
arxiv-1910-01920.description: Abstract In this note we explore a non-static spacetime in quantum regime in the background of f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity. The time dependent Vaidya metric which represents the spacetime of a radiating body like star is studied in an energy dependent gravity’s rainbow, which is a UV completion of General Relativity.

arxiv-2109-02531.description: Abstract Motivated by the latest discovery of a new tetraquark T c ​ c + T_{cc}^{+} with two charm quarks and two light antiquarks by LHCb Collaboration, we investigated the D ​ D ∗ DD^{*} hadronic molecule interpretation of T c ​ c + T_{cc}^{+} .

arxiv-2112-12453.title: Ergodic Optimization restricted on certain subsets of invariant measures
arxiv-2112-12453.creator: Wanshan Lin and Xueting Tian
arxiv-2112-12453.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Wanshan Lin and Xueting Tian. In this article, we pay attention to transitive dynamical systems having the shadowing property and the entropy functions are upper semicontinuous. As for these dynamical systems, when we consider ergodic optimization restricted on the subset of invariant measures whose metric entropy are equal or greater than a given constant, we prove that for generic real continuous functions the ergodic optimization measure is unique, ergodic, full support and have metric entropy equal to the given constant.

arxiv-2401-14120.title: Heavy baryon decays into light meson and dark baryon within LCSR
arxiv-2401-14120.creator: Yu-Ji Shi 1,2 , Ye Xing 3 and Zhi-Peng Xing 4
arxiv-2401-14120.description: Abstract We studied the decays of Heavy baryon into a pseudoscalar meson and a dark baryon in the recently developed B B -Mesogenesis scenario, where the two types of effective Lagrangians proposed by the scenario are both considered. The decay amplitudes of Λ b 0 \Lambda_{b}^{0} are calculated by light-cone sum rules using its light-cone distribution amplitudes.

arxiv-2404-05659.title: VietMed: A Dataset and Benchmark for Automatic Speech Recognition of Vietnamese in the Medical Domain
arxiv-2404-05659.creator: Khai Le-Duc *
arxiv-2404-05659.description: Abstract Due to privacy restrictions, there’s a shortage of publicly available speech recognition datasets in the medical domain. In this work, we present VietMed - a Vietnamese speech recognition dataset in the medical domain comprising 16h of labeled medical speech, 1000h of unlabeled medical speech and 1200h of unlabeled general-domain speech.

arxiv-2411-11982.title: HPA-MPC: Hybrid Perception-Aware Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Quadrotors with Suspended Loads
arxiv-2411-11982.creator: Mrunal Sarvaiya, Guanrui Li, Giuseppe Loianno
arxiv-2411-11982.description: Abstract Quadrotors equipped with cable-suspended loads represent a versatile, low-cost, and energy efficient solution for aerial transportation, construction, and manipulation tasks. However, their real-world deployment is hindered by several challenges. The system is difficult to control because it is nonlinear, underactuated, involves hybrid dynamics due to slack-taut cable modes, and evolves on complex configuration spaces.

arxiv-2502-01425.title: The Batch Complexity of Bandit Pure Exploration
arxiv-2502-01425.creator: Adrienne Tuynman, Rémy Degenne
arxiv-2502-01425.description: Abstract In a fixed-confidence pure exploration problem in stochastic multi-armed bandits, an algorithm iteratively samples arms and should stop as early as possible and return the correct answer to a query about the arms distributions. We are interested in batched methods, which change their sampling behaviour only a few times, between batches of observations.

arxiv-2505-04339.title: Adaptive and Robust DBSCAN with Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2505-04339.creator: Hao Peng, Xiang Huang, Shuo Sun, Ruitong Zhang, Philip S. Yu
arxiv-2505-04339.description: Abstract DBSCAN, a well-known density-based clustering algorithm, has gained widespread popularity and usage due to its effectiveness in identifying clusters of arbitrary shapes and handling noisy data. However, it encounters challenges in producing satisfactory cluster results when confronted with datasets of varying density scales, a common scenario in real-world applications.

pmc-10744150.title: X-Linked Hypophosphatemia: Does Targeted Therapy Modify Dental Impairment?
pmc-10744150.creator: Anusha Abdullah, Sabina Noreen Wuersching, Maximilian Kollmuss, Philipp Poxleitner, Ina Dewenter, Leonard Simon Brandenburg, David Steybe, Florian Nepomuk Fegg, Wenko Smolka, Sven Otto, Katharina Theresa Obermeier
pmc-10744150.description: X-linked hypophosphatemia is a rare, hereditary disorder that significant influences teeth and alveolar bone. The first clinical sign leading to the diagnosis of X-linked hypophosphatemia is often dental impairment with dental abscesses and dentin mineralization defects. Genetic analysis helped find the responsible gene and therefore opened up new ways of therapeutically managing X-linked hypophosphatemia.

pmc-11450393.title: Different development patterns of reward behaviors induced by ketamine and JWH-018 in striatal GAD67 knockdown mice
pmc-11450393.creator: Sun Mi Gu, Eunchong Hong, Sowoon Seo, Sanghyeon Kim, Seong Shoon Yoon, Hye Jin Cha, Jaesuk Yun
pmc-11450393.description: ImportanceGlutamic acid decarboxylase 67 (GAD67) is a gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) synthesis enzyme associated with the function of other neurotransmitter receptors, such as the N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor and cannabinoid receptor 1. However, the role of GAD67 in the development of different abused drug-induced reward behaviors remains unknown.

pmc-11591623.title: H2S-Eluting Hydrogels Promote In Vitro Angiogenesis and Augment In Vivo Ischemic Wound Revascularization
pmc-11591623.creator: Joseph Giacolone, Robin Osofsky, Benjamin Matheson, Gabriela Perales, Reza Shekarriz, Nancy Kanagy, Ross M Clark, Ryan Moseley
pmc-11591623.description: Ischemic wounds are frequently encountered in clinical practice and may be related to ischemia secondary to diabetes, peripheral artery disease and other chronic conditions. Angiogenesis is critical to the resolution of ischemia. Hydrogen sulfide (H2S) is now recognized as an important factor in this process.

pmc-11618434.title: An optimal design for an automatic voltage regulation system using a multivariable PID controller based on hybrid simulated annealing – white shark optimization
pmc-11618434.creator: Ahmed K. Ali
pmc-11618434.description: This paper combines the simulated annealing (SA) and white shark optimisation (WSO) algorithms to create a novel hybrid metaheuristic algorithm named SA–WSO. The proposed algorithm finds the best approach to tuning the parameters of three types of regulators. Three types of proportional–integral–derivative (PID) controllers are utilized for an automatic voltage regulator (AVR) system, including fractional–order (FOPID) –controllers.

pmc-11624569.title: Comparison of Clinical Outcomes Between Arthroscopic Rotator Cuff Repair and Reverse Total Shoulder Arthroplasty in Patients With Massive Rotator Cuff Tears and High-Grade Fatty Atrophy Without Glenohumeral Osteoarthritis
pmc-11624569.creator: Diego Gonzalez-Morgado, Tammy R. Hoffman, Javier Ardebol, Matthew B. Noble, Lisa A. Galasso, Matthew Nugent, Cameron Phillips, Patrick J. Denard
pmc-11624569.description: Background:Despite the effectiveness of reverse total shoulder arthroplasty (RSA) and arthroscopic rotator cuff repair (ARCR) for treating massive rotator cuff tears (MRCTs), controversies remain in patients without glenohumeral osteoarthritis (GHOA).Purpose:To compare clinical outcomes of ARCR or RSA in patients with MRCT with high-grade fatty atrophy without GHOA.Study Design:Cohort study; Level of evidence, 3.

pmc-12516658.title: Impact of Donor Type on Outcomes After Allogeneic Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation in Myelofibrosis: A Study on Behalf of the Chronic Malignancies Working Party of the EBMT
pmc-12516658.creator: Juan Carlos Hernández‐Boluda, Vipul Sheth, Simona Iacobelli, Linda Koster, Nicolaus Kröger, Patrizia Chiusolo, Thomas Schroeder, Marie Robin, Massimiliano Gambella, Didier Blaise, Henrik Sengeloev, Jakob Passweg, Mattias Stelljes, Robert Zeiser, Ibrahim Yakoub‐Agha, Andrew Clark, Urpu Salmenniemi, P
pmc-12516658.description: Selecting the optimal donor is crucial for optimizing results of allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (allo‐HCT). We analyzed outcomes based on donor type in 2809 myelofibrosis (MF) patients undergoing first allo‐HCT between 2015 and 2021 at EBMT centers. Study outcomes included overall survival (OS), progression‐free survival (PFS), relapse, non‐relapse mortality (NRM), engraftment, and graft‐versus‐host disease (GvHD).

pmc-13093637.description: Latin America is undergoing rapid population aging alongside a rising burden of dementia. While the region holds substantial potential for dementia risk reduction, challenges remain, such as delayed diagnoses, limited access to specialized care and biomarker testing, persistent stigma, and deep‐rooted structural inequities.

pmc-13202916.title: Arecoline-induced EV-mediated ZNF582 hypermethylation drives IFIT1–PD-L1 immune evasion in oral squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-13202916.creator: Hui-Hsin Ko, Hsin-Hui Peng, Chun-Pin Chiang, Hsiang-Fong Kao, Hung-Ying Lin, Mark Yen-Ping Kuo, Shih-Jung Cheng

pmc-13687490.creator: Enes Kavrut
pmc-13687490.description: In this study, edible films were prepared using pectin (PEC) and whey protein isolate (WPI), and additional film formulations were developed by incorporating thyme essential oil to these polymer matrices.
